about.title: Del Rey Oaks Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Del Rey Oaks is a small place. With fewer than 1,700 residents, a death here is felt on nearly every block, and public collision records for 2025 show no traffic fatalities within city limits. That does not mean local families are never left with a wrongful death claim. Residents commute daily on Rt 68, Canyon Del Rey Boulevard, General Jim Moore Boulevard and Rt 218, and losses also come from hospital errors, care-facility neglect, workplace accidents and defective products, sometimes far from home. California limits who may bring a wrongful death action, generally starting with a spouse or domestic partner and children, then extending to certain dependents and heirs. The claim is civil and moves separately from any criminal case, and it generally must be filed within two years of the death, with a shorter window when a public entity is involved. LawProactive is a free service, not a law firm. We listen, then connect you with an independent Monterey County attorney who handles these cases on contingency.

whyChoose.title: Why Del Rey Oaks Families Reach Out to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on Who Can File
items.desc: California allows only certain people to bring a wrongful death action, beginning with a spouse or domestic partner and children, then certain dependents and heirs. The attorney we connect you with can sort out standing early, before time is lost.

items.title: The Deadline Is Watched
items.desc: Most claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window is considerably shorter when a city, county, or state agency is involved. Getting connected promptly protects that timeline.

items.title: Losses Counted Honestly
items.desc: Recoverable damages can include funeral and burial costs, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of love, companionship and guidance. Your attorney documents each of these; no outcome is ever promised.

items.question: Public records show no traffic deaths in Del Rey Oaks in 2025. Do wrongful death claims still come up here?
items.answer: Yes. A small city with few recorded crashes inside its limits still has residents who drive Rt 68 and Rt 218 every day, receive care at regional hospitals, and work on job sites across Monterey County. A wrongful death claim follows the family, not the city boundary, so where the death occurred does not limit your ability to seek help through LawProactive.

items.question: The other driver is facing criminal charges. Do we have to wait for that case to finish?
items.answer: No. A California wrongful death action is a civil case that runs separately from any criminal prosecution. A criminal conviction is not required for the civil claim, and waiting for the criminal case to end could put you up against the two-year filing deadline. An attorney can begin preserving evidence right away.

items.question: What if a government vehicle or public road condition was involved?
items.answer: Claims against a public entity, including Caltrans on Rt 68 or a city or county agency, follow a much shorter timeline than the standard two years, and a formal claim must usually be presented before any lawsuit is filed. Because those windows close quickly, it is worth getting connected with an attorney as soon as you feel able. LawProactive can make that connection at no cost to you.
